answers.goal: Definitely still figuring this out! As I mentioned, I love bringing people together through creative experiences, and have mainly done this through design and live event production. I see my ultimate goal as being a director or project manager in roles that combine and build on these interests, while connecting to communities that are largely misrepresented and undervalued in entertainment.
answers.drew: As someone with a huge passion for, and background in, Sports Entertainment- I find the connection between a team/ show/ any production and the audience as something really endearing and personal. I love to bring people together through these creative experiences, and am excited to continue doing so within the entertainment industry.
answers.seeking: I'm hoping to connect with other creatives - both those hoping to break into the industry, as well as others who are more established. I'm really looking forward to meeting new friendly faces and hear about everyone's stories and experiences.
answers.inspiration: Have to be cheesy and say my mother :') Throughout my childhood, she has shown so much strength and resilience while constantly aiming to grow and reach new bounds in life. From immigrating into the US and learning an entirely new language and culture to raise us here, to navigating legal and financial structures to launch her own non-profit in support of Sudanese women and youth in LA, I've never seen her give up or quit. I'm so grateful to be raised by such an ambitious woman, and she genuinely inspires me everyday.
